scenes.heading: Building a content system so you don't run out of ideas

sents.d: Building a content system so you don't run out of ideas
A repeatable system beats waiting for inspiration to strike.

Waiting for inspiration before each piece of content is a common cause of inconsistent posting — a running idea list, added to whenever inspiration does strike, ensures you're never starting from a blank page under deadline pressure.
Batching content creation (filming or writing several pieces in one sitting, rather than one at a time) tends to be significantly more time-efficient than a scattered daily creation process.
Revisiting and repurposing your own best-performing past content into new formats or updated versions is an underused way to keep a content calendar full without needing constant entirely new ideas.

take: Capture ideas, batch creation and recycle your best work.
